name: IncottFramedMouse
source_reference: design brief only: the app's own design language (ui/style.css tokens) and the app's tray icon, which is drawn in code (src-tauri/src/tray.rs). No logo, no bitmap reference.
brief: A framed key: graphite stage; inside it the tray icon's own mark — a white outline square frame with a slim solid white mouse and one green connected-lamp dot.

semantic_review.basis: original concept authored in-task from the app's own design language; no external brand mark and no bitmap reference to reproduce
semantic_review.notes: The outline frame is the mark itself (the same frame the tray icon draws directly on the taskbar), not a decorative rim: it carries the square outline so the mouse can stay slim at every size. Frame, mouse and lamp are filled shapes; the hollow of the frame and the notch are background-coloured overlays (no boolean cutout, no stroke).

app_context.job_to_be_done: let the user recognise the mouse driver in the taskbar, Start menu and installer at a glance
app_context.tone: calm, precise, hardware-instrument; no AI-flavoured purple, glow or gradients

style_direction: custom direction from the app UI (单色仪表台); nearest built-in family: black-stage-mark

source_analysis.fidelity_target: the tray icon's composition (outline frame + slim mouse + lamp) on the app's graphite; proportions in frame units, frame edge = 24: stroke 2, mouse 12 × 16, notch 1.5 wide starting 1.2 below the top, lamp r 1.8 centred 3.5 below the middle
must_preserve: outline square frame as the main mark: 74% of the canvas, corner radius 22.5% of the frame
single continuous mouse silhouette inside the frame: elliptical dome, straight sides, elliptical bottom, half the frame wide
notch as a closed background-coloured slot from near the top to 40% of the mouse height
one green lamp dot on the lower body

spec_constraints: background-coloured rounded square inset by the stroke width: leaves a hollow frame, no cutout
rounded rect overlay in background colour

acceptance_checks: preview and app PNG inspected at full size and 64px

layers.name: frame
layers.svg: <rect x="133" y="133" width="758" height="758" rx="170" fill="#EDEDEE"/>

composer.reason: the outline frame is the main mark; a filled rounded square keeps it editable
background-coloured overlay inset by the 32 px stroke: hollows the frame without a cutout
same slim silhouette as the tray icon; stays editable as one flat path
background-coloured overlay: the button notch, closed at the top so it does not run into the frame
the one meaningful accent: connected lamp
